item.title: Purchase & Support
item.description:
📌 Whether you’re buying your first embroidery machine, need repair support, want training, or looking for the latest deals – we’re here to help.

How to purchase an embroidery machine?

Kimi offers a range of embroidery machines for home users and factories alike. The purchasing process is simple and transparent, with online consultations, video demos, and remote previews available.

For detailed quotes and model info, contact Flora Huang.
